name: 耳朵对称性分析
description: Examines ear shape and symmetry consistency
algorithm: Ear Symmetry Analysis — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes bilateral ear symmetry for deepfake detection:

1. **BilateralEar检测**: Both ears are detected when visible. Their geometric landmarks — helix attachment point, lobule tip, tragion, ear length, ear width, protrusion angle — are measured per frame.

2. **对称性分析**: Natural ears exhibit consistent but imperfect bilateral symmetry (minor asymmetry is normal). The method quantifies symmetry metrics: size ratio, shape similarity (procrustes distance), and protrusion angle difference. Deepfakes may produce: (a) perfectly symmetric ears (too artificial), (b) grossly asymmetric ears (generator inconsistency), or (c) ears symmetric in ways inconsistent with natural anatomical variation.

3. **HeadPose-Corrected比较**: Apparent ear asymmetry changes with head pose — the closer ear appears larger due to perspective. The method corrects for head pose using estimated 3D head orientation, comparing ears in a pose-normalized framework. Deepfakes may show incorrect perspective scaling of ears.

4. **时间对称性稳定性**: The ratio and shape relationship between ears should remain constant across frames (bone/cartilage doesn't change shape). The method tracks bilateral symmetry metrics over time — temporal variation in ear symmetry indicates generation artifacts where the two ears are rendered independently per frame.

5. **对称性异常评分**: The combined assessment of static symmetry plausibility, pose-corrected comparison, and temporal stability generates a forensic score. Methods like FaceForensics++ have shown that peripheral face regions (ears, hairline) carry important manipulation cues often overlooked by face-centric generators.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through ear symmetry analysis analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
